logline: A volatile architect and a grieving musician collide in Mumbai and fall apart repeatedly in a romance that substitutes toxicity for passion - until Season 3 resets the entire canvas with new leads.

renewal.note: Three seasons concluded in 2021. Ekta Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms produced all three seasons; no Season 4 has been announced.

bollymeter.basis: Vikrant Massey's performance as the wounded, mercurial Veer drove strong audience word-of-mouth on ALT Balaji. The chemistry with Harleen Sethi was the series' main selling point and its critics' primary praise.

seasons.review_body: Broken But Beautiful debuted on ALT Balaji in November 2018 as Ekta Kapoor's attempt to translate the emotional extremes of Hindi romantic fiction into a short-form streaming format. The first season pairs architect Veer Shekhavat (Vikrant Massey) with musician Sameera Joshi (Harleen Sethi) across eleven episodes that foreground obsessive attachment over conventional romance. The characterisation was frequently called thin by reviewers, yet the performances emerged as the load-bearing element: Massey brought bruised specificity to a role that could easily have been a type. Audience reception on ALT Balaji was strong enough to justify a quick renewal. The writing's willingness to leave the central relationship genuinely damaged rather than tidily resolved gave it a sharper edge than most Indian OTT romances of its vintage. For the genre it inhabits - hurt-people-hurting-each-other romance - Season 1 earns its fanbase.

bollymeter.basis: Season 2 returned Massey and Sethi in a story that revisited the same emotional register without meaningfully advancing it - functional for existing fans, thin for anyone else.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 of Broken But Beautiful returned in November 2019 with Veer and Sameera once again and ten episodes that largely replayed the first season's emotional grammar. Vikrant Massey and Harleen Sethi retained the chemistry that made Season 1 work, and the show's core audience followed. The problem the writers faced - and largely did not solve - was how to escalate a romance built on cyclical damage without simply repeating the cycle. The result is a season that satisfies completionists and exhausts newcomers. The production quality on ZEE5 was consistent with Season 1, and the series remained a reliable vehicle for its two leads, but the narrative ambition did not match the audience's apparent hunger for something more.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 2 replays the emotional architecture of Season 1 without significantly escalating the stakes for Veer and Sameera.

bollymeter.basis: The Sidharth Shukla - Sonia Rathee pairing arrived with significant audience anticipation following Shukla's Bigg Boss 13 visibility. Critics noted strong on-screen presence though the story itself did not depart far from the series template.

seasons.review_body: Season 3 of Broken But Beautiful arrived on ZEE5 in May 2021 as a near-complete reset: new leads, new story, the same structural blueprint. Sidharth Shukla played Agastya Rao, a driven creative professional drawn into a toxic orbit with Rumi Desai (Sonia Rathee), and the pairing attracted attention partly due to Shukla's substantial post-Bigg Boss 13 fanbase. The season gave the franchise renewed commercial energy, though the formula had not evolved much from the first two runs. What Season 3 demonstrated is that the Broken But Beautiful template is robust enough to survive a full cast rotation - the emotional architecture of attraction-damage-longing travels across different actors and scenarios. Shukla's performance drew generally positive audience response before his death in September 2021 lent the season an unavoidable retrospective weight.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 3 replaces both leads entirely, giving the franchise a fresh entry point while maintaining the same emotionally volatile relationship template.
